rogue.label: Tess
rogue.description: A slippery opportunist who retreats, swaps places, and leaves someone else holding the blame.

rogue_blame_furniture.label: Blame the Furniture
rogue_blame_furniture.help: Mark an enemy. Its next attack hits an adjacent damageable obstacle instead, if one is present when it attacks.

rogue_confusing_dodge.label: Confusing Dodge
rogue_confusing_dodge.help: Swap with the furthest other living character, friend or foe. Distance ties go to the lowest character ID.

direct.help: Swap places with a chosen living character, friend or foe, if both can enter the other's tile.

rogue_wasnt_me.label: Wasn't Me
rogue_wasnt_me.help: Choose an enemy beside another living character. Its next attack redirects to an adjacent character other than its original target, lowest ID first. If none exists, the attack proceeds normally.
